senses.gloss:
मड् (इ) मडि r. 1st cl. (मण्डते)
 1. To divide, to separate.
 2. To clothe 3.
To surround, to encompass. r. 1st and 10th cls. (मण्डति मण्डयति-ते)
To adorn, to grace, to decorate. r. 10th cl. (मण्डयति-ते) To gladden,
to rejoice, to make happy.
माड्(ऋ)माडृ r. 1st cl. (माडति-ते) To measure, to weigh.

मडक m. (-कः) A kind of grain, (Eleusine corocana.)
 E. मडि-क्वुन् ।

माड m. (-डः)
 1. Weight or quantity.
 2. A species of tree.
 E. माड् to
weigh, अच् aff.

माड्डुक m. (-कः) A drummer, a player on a sort of drum called Maḍ-
ḍaka or Maḍḍu. q. v.
 E. मड्डु and अण् aff.; also with ठक् aff.
माड्डुकिक ।
